verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants search docs, trigger tasks, deploy projects, and monitor runs, so users can operate the platform in natural language through an external AI client. Agent Skills help those assistants use it correctly. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language command interface in the dashboard or CLI. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language command surface, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the MCP-driven operation works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Give your AI assistant direct access to Trigger.dev tools — search docs, trigger tasks, deploy projects, and monitor runs.
The Trigger.dev MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server enables AI assistants to interact directly with your Trigger.dev projects.
Get task information and trigger task runs, Deploy projects to different environments, Monitor run details
